title: Make SGI capabilities assessable with outputs and quality measures
requirements:
- Separate monitoring of governance process, content quality, implementation conformance and adoption
- Give each capability an expected output, accountable owner, evidence and maturity definition
- Define quality dimensions and a runtime semantic-error taxonomy, and extend service monitoring beyond availability
- Add governance-process indicators (backlog, triage, review, publication times) and outcome indicators linking SGI to interoperability results
- Measure validated and production use rather than raw access volume
- Offer the catalogue as an editable assessment workbook / operating-model template rather than only a dense PDF table
- Keep usage monitoring proportionate and privacy-preserving
